actions.target: Audit and fix observation.state[8] format to match LIBERO real semantics
actions.current_problem_detail: Infinigen state format: [eef_pos(3) + eef_quat(4) + gripper_binary{0,1}] — MINT processor_mint.py digitizes state[7] to 256 bins → text token. LIBERO state[7]: continuous joint position (min=-0.041, max=0.001, std=0.013). Infinigen {0,1} lands in completely wrong bins → MINT state tokenizer confused → gripper never closes (ever_attached=false).
